title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the metadata item reads and the layered read through the protocol host (#25467 E2 cut 1b)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9UmbUGPtw5rdRcd3UpYXs5N)_

Part of #25467

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：把 `protocol.ts` 里“元数据读取”一节的后半（单项读取 `getMetaItem`、`getMetaItemForExecution` 及二者共享的私有 `readMetaItem`，外加分层读取 `packagelessLayeredReadRefusal`、`getMetaItemLayered`）的方法体，经 E1 的宿主机制原样搬进两个新模块；5 个方法仍留在类上（签名与文档不变），方法体变成一行转发。
- **为什么改**：#25467 裁决 E 的 E2 第 1 节后半（1b），接在已合并的 1a（#29548）之后，在声明的 `protocol.ts` 冻结日内；第 1 节到此搬完。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只做搬移：工具逐个证明 5 个方法体与原方法体在“`this.` 读作 `host.`”之外 AST 与文本全同；对外 `index.d.ts`（ESM 与 CJS）与 main 构建出的逐字节相同，`getMetaTypes()` 的推断类型块也逐字节相同。回滚即整体 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` 文件头；`protocol.ts` 里 5 个方法的转发体与类 `static {}` 块新增的宿主条目；`protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts` 的改动。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd packages/metadata-protocol && node scripts/host-split.mjs check origin/main readMetaItem protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`，预期 `"ok":true,"textIdentical":true`。
- **需要你做的**：无（约 2,575 行，低于 3,000 行线，席位自审）。

## What changes

Step **E2, section 1 "metadata reads", part 1b** of ruling E (6537939895), on the `protocol.ts` freeze day seat 5 declared (#28677). It follows 1a (#29548) and finishes section 1. This is a pure application of the E1 host pattern: no logic changes, and no new rewrite kind. Before cutting, the director's #29465 A condition was checked: no `protocol.ts` codemod card has been claimed (the one codemod card, #29520, is the `sql-driver.ts` pilot).

| member | moved to | rewrite sites (all `this.x` to `host.x`) |
|---|---|---:|
| `getMetaItem` | `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` | 1 |
| `getMetaItemForExecution` | `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` | 1 |
| `readMetaItem` (private, 684 lines) | `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` | 46 |
| `packagelessLayeredReadRefusal` | `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` | 1 |
| `getMetaItemLayered` (496 lines) | `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` | 24 |

Each method keeps its docblock, modifiers and signature on the class; its body becomes `return fn(protocolHost(this), …)`. `ProtocolHost` and the class's static block gain 22 entries, all call-time closures (the other members these bodies read were already on the host). `node scripts/host-split.mjs check origin/main MEMBER MODULE` reads `ok: true, textIdentical: true` for all five, and the tool refused none. Negative control, with `code === null` changed to `!==` in `getMetaItemLayered`'s moved body, then restored:

```
PROBLEM protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts:183: ExclamationEqualsEqualsToken where the base has EqualsEqualsEqualsToken (`===`)
PROBLEM protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts: getMetaItemLayered's body text differs from the base body rewritten and re-indented, first at body line 64
```

`protocol.ts` drops ten import names only the moved bodies used: `isTenantAuthored`, `storedDraftChanges`, `computeViewReferenceDiagnostics`, `decorateMetadataItem`, `withFormLayoutWarnings`, `withPublishVerdict`, `isObjectOfDisabledPackage`, `noPendingDraftError`, `objectPackageDisabledError` and `envelopePackageId`. Each module imports what its bodies read from where `protocol.ts` imports it. Two import comments belonged to dropped names, and each moves with its name rather than being lost:

- the `[#21059]` note on `isTenantAuthored` now stands on that import in `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`;
- the `[#24395]` note's half about the draft row's per-key provenance (`storedDraftChanges`) now stands in `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`, and `protocol.ts` keeps the half about the authoring surface.

## Forced test edit

One by-path pin reads through the split. What it asserts is unchanged.

`src/protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`:

- The three `readMetaItem` site rows carry `file: 'protocol-meta-item-reads.ts'`, and the `getMetaItemLayered` row carries `file: 'protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts'`, where those bodies now stand.
- "Both read doors take their envelope from one rule" required `protocol.ts` to import `envelopePackageId` from `protocol-package-bindings.ts`. Neither door stands in `protocol.ts` any more, so it now requires the item read's module to import that one definition and to define no copy, as 1a did for the list read's module. `protocol.ts` must still define no copy.

Ablation, with the item read's `envelopePackageId(request.packageId, item)` argument changed to `request.packageId` in the module, then restored: `Tests 1 failed | 5 passed (6)`, `a site with no recorded disposition … expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal []`.

The read-verb pin, the `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` caller-set pin (1a's edit already reads the modules) and the read-seam census needed no edit. Read-verb ablation, dropping the fold from `getMetaItemLayered`'s moved body, then restored: `Tests 1 failed | 17 passed (18)`, `expected [ 'getMetaItemLayered' ] to deeply equal []`. The census reads 100 seams, the same as main.

## The published `.d.ts`

Built from main 85f77e93d7 (1a's merge, this branch's base) and from this head. `index.d.ts` is byte-identical: raw sha256 `97e36a54…d6c680` on both sides, ESM equal to CJS, normaliser 2 `b73fbce4…a55114` on both. The raw diff of `getMetaTypes()`'s emitted block (793 lines, its return type still inferred per the seat's E1 ruling) is empty. The declaration-emit comment leak that struck 1a did not strike this cut, so no comment length was adjusted. Before the replay onto 85f77e93d7, the same cut stacked on 1a's head read byte-identical to main 399df5bba8 too (`450c9334…5d744e`).

## Serial

1a (#29548) landed as one squashed commit, 85f77e93d7. This branch was restarted from main at dbca3ef034 and the three 1b commits were replayed onto it. `host-split check` was re-run against the new main for all five members, and the suite, the dependents, the `.d.ts` and the gates below were re-run on the replayed head. Re-read just before opening against main d3175d59d0, 9 commits later. One of those, #29437, touches `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` only. `git merge-tree` with main is clean.

Open PRs whose own diff touches `protocol.ts` or a `protocol-*.ts` module:

- #29456 (`protocol.ts` and `protocol-credential-carry-forward.ts`). Its hunks sit in the import list, `carryForwardRedactedCredentials` and `saveMetaItem`. All of them are outside the moved section, which runs from `getMetaItem`, main line 4576, through `getMetaItemLayered`'s end, before `auditMetaItem`'s stub at line 5968. `git merge-tree` with this head is clean.

Seat 3's #29390 work (branch `claude/project-thread-gvqm55`, head d776e25828, no PR yet) touches the restore limb, which is outside the moved section. `git merge-tree` with this head is clean.

## Gates

On 3912b131ff (the replayed head):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 61 commands, and each records `exit 0`.
- `--ran` reports 61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- The package's typecheck and test, through os-verify-lock, read Test Files 307 passed, 4 skipped; Tests 22232 passed, 26 skipped.
- The 11 direct dependents' typecheck exits 0.
- Lint (`eslint packages/metadata-protocol --no-inline-config`) exits 0.
- The census reads 100 seams.

The same battery was green before the replay (62 of 62, on the stack over 1a). CI is not read.
